description.value: Head of a terrace house of forty-one members and keeper of a pit culture that the house's own account puts at nine hundred years old. She has given the survey a standing invitation to the terraces and a standing silence on the descent of the culture, which she regards as a question about the house's kin rather than about its food. She sat for a photograph in 2301 on the condition that the pit did not appear in it, and the result is mostly wall.
